summary.description: One-line account of what was converted.

source.description: Memory path of the converted document.

outputDir.description: Memory folder holding raw.md, seed.md, assets/ and manifest.json.

markdownPath.description: Memory path of seed.md, the file to review and publish.

truncated.description: True when the document had more pages than were converted; manifest.json says why.

captions.description: Figure captions folded into their images.

citationsUnlinked.description: Bracketed citations with no reference entry, left as text.

markersRepaired.description: Markers Datalab left unpaired, a code fence, a $$ block or a **, that were repaired so they would not swallow what follows; manifest.json lists each with its line in raw.md.

keySource.description: Whose Datalab key paid: the space's own, or the server's shared one.

usage.description: Pages spent on the shared key; absent on a space's own key.
